macc_h2_0.text: Did you know Hovis started in Macclesfield? A miller called Richard Smith patented the wheatgerm flour in 1886.
The name came a few years later, from the Latin for 'strength of man'. I say it also means strength of toast.

macc_h2_1.text: Dad says the 108 Steps are good for the legs. I say they are good for complaining.
